messages.title: Standard Greeting
messages.text:
Hello!

I hope you are doing well today. I will be assisting you with this ticket.

messages.title: Greeting - AnyDesk Download Steps
messages.text:
Hi!

I’m from the IT department, and it’s a pleasure to meet you! I’m reaching out regarding your request. To assist you, please follow these steps:

Download the AnyDesk program:
If you’re using Windows, you can download it from this link: https://anydesk.com/en or search for it in your browser.
If you’re using macOS, please download it from this link: https://anydesk.com/en/downloads/mac-os

Install the program:
On Windows: Follow the on-screen installation instructions.
On macOS: After installation, go to System Settings > Privacy & Security and grant AnyDesk access to Screen Recording and Accessibility.

Open AnyDesk and send me your AnyDesk address (a 9–11 digit code).

Important: While I am connected to your computer, please do not leave your device without notifying me first.

Please note that we are no longer able to accept IT support requests via direct messages. Kindly submit a ticket through IT Helpdesk. Thank you for your understanding!

messages.title: Follow-Up Message
messages.text:
Hello!

I am just checking in regarding your ticket. Are you still experiencing the issue?

messages.title: Ticket Closure Notification - Issue Resolved
messages.text:
Hi there!

I wanted to follow up on your ticket. Since I haven't heard back from you, I'll be closing the ticket for now. If you still need assistance, please don't hesitate to reach out again. Thank you!

messages.title: Ticket Closure Notification - No Response
messages.text:
Hi there!

I wanted to follow up on your ticket. Since I haven't heard back from you, I'll be closing the ticket for now. If you still need assistance, please don't hesitate to reach out again. Thank you!

messages.title: Ask User to Get Approval
messages.text: Okay great, can you please obtain approval to proceed with the requested changes? You can send me a screenshot of the approval once you have it.

messages.title: Ask for AnyDesk ID
messages.text: Could you please provide me with your AnyDesk ID so that I can remotely access your computer to assist you further?

categories.name: Laptop & Virtual Machine Issues and Requests

messages.title: Checks Before Laptop Replacement
messages.text: We have received your request for a replacement laptop. Before proceeding, I will run some checks on your device to see if the issue can be fixed.

messages.title: Sign Out and Sign In
messages.text: Can you please try signing out of your account and then signing back in?

messages.title: Device Restart
messages.text: Please try restarting your device and let me know if the issue persists.

messages.title: Laptop Hard Restart Steps
messages.text:
To perform a hard restart on your laptop, please follow these steps:

1. Press and hold the power button on your laptop for about 10–15 seconds until the device powers off completely.
2. Wait a few seconds to ensure that the laptop is fully turned off.
3. Press the power button again to turn the laptop back on.

Once your laptop has restarted, please check if the issue has been resolved.

messages.title: Virtual Machine Restart Complete
messages.text: I have restarted your virtual machine. Please let me know if it is functioning better now.

messages.title: Request to Troubleshoot Laptop
messages.text:
Hello!

I hope you are doing well. I would like to connect to your device and perform some troubleshooting to resolve the issues with your laptop. Could you please let me know when I can connect?

messages.title: New Laptop Setup Steps
messages.text:
Hello!

I am reaching out regarding your new laptop, which requires some setup. I will be assisting you with this. Please let me know when you might have some time so we can begin the process.

messages.title: Company Portal Application Download Steps
messages.text:
Please follow these steps to download the application via Company Portal:

1. Search for the Company Portal app and sign in with your company credentials.
2. Once signed in, search for the application, open it, and click Install.

If you encounter any issues during this process or need further assistance, please let me know.

messages.title: Application Installation Complete
messages.text: The software has been successfully installed on your device.

messages.title: Application Installation in Progress
messages.text: I am currently installing the requested software on your device. I will let you know once it is completed.

messages.title: UiPath Bot Type Clarification
messages.text: Could you please specify which type of UiPath bot you would like to install?

messages.title: Temporary Admin Rights Granted - Mosyle
messages.text: Temporary admin rights have been granted. Please proceed with the installation and let me know once it is complete.

messages.title: Verify Level of Access
messages.text: Could you please let me know what access level should be granted?

messages.title: Time Estimate
messages.text: I estimate it might take 10–15 minutes to resolve your issue. I appreciate your patience while I work on it.

messages.title: Provide Temporary Workaround
messages.text: Would you like me to provide a temporary workaround while we work on a permanent solution?

messages.title: Escalation Confirmation
messages.text: I have escalated your issue to our senior admin team. They will review it and get back to you shortly.

messages.title: Temporary Workaround Implemented
messages.text: I have implemented a temporary workaround for the issue. Please let me know if it helps or if you need further assistance.

messages.title: New Device Setup Steps
messages.text:
To get started with your new Windows laptop, please follow these steps:

1. Power on your device.
2. Follow the on-screen setup instructions.
3. Connect to Wi-Fi.
4. Sign in using your INFUSE credentials.
5. Install AnyDesk from https://anydesk.com/en.
6. Share your AnyDesk ID with IT.

If you encounter any issues, feel free to reach out for assistance.

messages.title: Provide Helpdesk Link
messages.text: For better tracking and assistance, please log a ticket using this link: https://helpdesk.infuse.com. Thank you!

messages.title: Ticket Takeover Notification
messages.text: Hello! I have taken over your ticket and will be assisting you from now on. Please let me know if you have any questions.

messages.title: Ticket Reassignment Notification
messages.text: I have reassigned your ticket to another agent who will be able to assist you further. Please expect a follow-up message shortly.

messages.title: Ticket Escalation Notification
messages.text: Your ticket has been escalated to a higher-level support team. Please expect a follow-up message shortly.

messages.title: VPN Connection Issue
messages.text: I understand you are experiencing issues with your VPN connection. Could you please provide more details about the problem you are facing?

messages.title: Request Screenshot of Issue
messages.text: Could you please provide a screenshot of the error message or issue you are encountering?

messages.title: Login as Other User Steps - Windows
messages.text:
Please try the following steps:

1. On the login screen, click on 'Other User'.
2. Enter your username and password.
3. Let me know if the issue persists.

messages.title: Change Department Information
messages.text: Hello! I am aware you are changing departments soon. I will assist you with updating your information and access accordingly.

messages.title: Spam Email Steps
messages.text:
Thank you for reporting the spam email. Please do the following:

1. Do not click any links or attachments.
2. Forward the email to IT.
3. Delete the email from your inbox.

We will investigate and take appropriate action.
